title: Unreal Raspberry Red 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Unreal Raspberry’s ‘Red’ is a delicious blend of rich, sweet and unctuous cherry and everyone’s favourite syrupy sweet and irresistibly fruity blue raspberry slushy flavour. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
